pages.text: Use a wooden box side with a canopy to install it; sneak-use an exposed wooden side to remove it. Both forms are supported and size adapts to the box. Choose a canopy or a cover.$(br2)Use the front or rear curtains to open or close each pair independently.

Open curtains to enter the wagon or use cargo through an entrance. Fit stools and mats inside with sufficient passenger clearance.$(br2)The roof, side canvas and closed curtains form the solid shell. Choose passages tall and wide enough for the fitted canopy.

pages.text: The top row uses matching wool, which determines the canopy and curtain colour.
